newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Silgan rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Silgan rated buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Dan Khoshaba initiated Silgan Holdings Inc with a buy rating.
-- estimated earnings of $2 per share for 1997, and $2.50 for 1998 versus $1.24 for 1996.
-- said company is "continuing to pursue an aggressive growth strategy focused on increasing market share through acquisitions and internal growth."
-- said shares of the steel and aluminum container maker trade well below its peers. Shares were unchanged at 25-1/8.
